method: Actual production heavy flatcar + each of three real transport cargo models; production pose transform; createWarshipClearance triangle-edge/triangle crossing. No material masks, no wheel exclusions. Tests the 80 full-route OBB rejected poses. Rail geometry uses production Catmull/Tube and selects new approach triangles within1.3m of its exact curve. Finite surface crossing, not continuous sweep or coplanar/solid-containment proof.
